|description = When this dust is combined in a crafting deconstruction device with a magical item, the item will be stripped of all magical effects and qualities, but will then be keyed for further crafting.
|tips        = [[File:Dust of Disjunction store.png|right]]
* Used to remove all enchantments and effects from an item in order to make it craftable. No essences are recovered, but the raw item will remain, a "blank", ready for crafting. (Metals and augment slots are not affected.)
* Purchased individually.
* Can be stored in the Shared Crafting Storage.
* Does not remove curses from {{Item|Deck of Many Curses}}.{{Ref|{{Forums|12063}}}}
}}
